verdict.rationale: After you approve the plan, ReelMimic runs a multi-agent production pipeline on its own: up to 6 builder agents work in parallel, separate agents review each shot, and jobs pause and resume when limits are hit. The `post-video --at ... --send` command can also schedule a single post for a set time. That is one-off autonomous job execution, not user-defined automations that run on a recurring schedule or trigger. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow definitions, recurring schedules or triggers, documented always-on background operation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Up to 6 work on different parts of the video. Each finished shot goes to a new agent for review, so nobody grades their own work.
If you hit a limit, the job pauses and can pick up where it stopped.
npm run post-video -- <project id> --platforms tiktok --at 2026-10-05T18:00 --tz Europe/Madrid --send
How many agents work on one video at once (default 6), and the limit across all projects (default 12)
